title: What's the Best Month for Getting Hired?
paragraphs: January often feels like the perfect time for a fresh start. And for many people, that means looking for a new job.
But if you're hoping to get hired, you may want to wait a few months — at least if you're in the US.
According to new data from career platform Enhancv, June may actually be the best month to get a new job in America.
Enhancv looked at government hiring data from 2021 to 2025, as well as activity from 1.8 million resumes created on its platform. It also surveyed 500 recruiters and hiring managers.
The results showed that job seekers and employers are working on very different calendars.

Downloads of Enhancv resumes were highest at the start of the year, at 11.6% above average in January and 13.9% above average in February. Downloading a resume from the platform means a user has finished preparing it and is likely getting ready to apply for jobs, so Enhancv used downloads as a measure of job seeker activity.
But hiring was 3.4% below average in January and 15.3% below average in February. That means job seekers face more competition from one another at a time when employers are doing less hiring.
June was the opposite. Hiring was 16.3% above average — the highest of any month — while resume activity was 8% below average.
The next-best times for hiring were May, July and August.
So why does hiring improve during these months?
Around 40% of recruiters said budget approvals and the timing of a company's financial year can slow hiring at the start of the year.
Job postings also increase before hiring does: postings peak in April, with hiring often following one or two months later.
Meanwhile, December was found to be the slowest month for hiring, at 26.5% below average.
